title: Chart Advisor: A Four-Year Base Just Broke In Healthcare
summary: Healthcare just had its best week ever against the S&P 500.Most investors are buying the wrong half of it. Money went where it always goes first, into Lilly, J&J, AbbVie and UnitedHealth, and those names earned the move.
